ruleDefinitions.name: Impacket PsExec Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of Impacket's psexec.py. Note: Unmapped fields: ShareName, RelativeTargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND ShareName = "\\\\\*\\IPC\$" AND (RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*RemCom\\_stdin.*") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*RemCom\\_stdout.*") OR RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*RemCom\\_stderr.*")))
